source: due2-native: a refined action with no rdf:value (follow-up review F03, #122)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: an action node names its action by rdf:value when it carries a refinement (IM 2.5.4), and this one states none, so it names no action and has no odrl:includedIn (IM 2.4). Before decisions/0034's amendment of 2026-10-25, both checkers exempted every blank action node from the hierarchy check, so this policy passed the ODRL layer. Contrast due2-refined-action-skolem, which states its rdf:value.

expected_rejection.why: ex:print's action is a blank node with no rdf:value, so it is an action without an odrl:includedIn (IM 2.4, decisions/0034). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
